entry_points.text: CAD entry schedules deferred restart work when flag enabled, otherwise signals configured pid resolving globally held pid under read-side protection through thread-group delivery.

Early reboot parsing consumes comma-separated tokens selecting warm, cold, hard, soft or gpio modes, single-letter type codes, force flag and optional CPU with range validation, disabling automatic defaults when any token present.

Per-CPU log files offer open, poll, mapped access, sequential read and release bound to buffer reference held across open lifetime with non-seekable semantics; poll signals error for finalized buffers.
Two proc sequence views expose port and memory hierarchies with shared iteration callbacks.

exports.text: Privileged seccomp query needing admin with caller disabled, clamping size to record size and rejecting below offset, reporting logging flag and size; native and compat siginfo import entries; failures for bad size or mode, missing privilege and copy faults.

Native and compat ptrace handling self without lookup, resolving others by id with no-such-process on failure, routing attach to attach path and others via validation with termination and interrupt handling to arch handler then conditional thaw. Compat serves peek, poke, event, siginfo and regset with vector check and length writeback; short transfers and faults fail.

Range-set over caller array with capacity and count where zero end marks empty. Append adds interval, merging coalesces overlapping or touching and compacts. Remove clears covered, trims edges and splits straddled needing spare slot or trailing lost with log. Empty or inverted never mutates, full unchanged so callers compare counts. Compaction moves live forward, recounts and orders by start.

Reboot notifier registration plain and device-managed binding removal to device release warning on failure. Restart registration over atomic chain with trigger notifying mode and command and preparation helper notifying preparation chain; preparations sleepable while restart atomic.

Unified shutdown framework plain, device-managed and platform; modes power-off prep, power-off, restart prep and restart with preparations blocking and others atomic, default plain else unique. Unknown fails invalid. Allocation zeroes atomic past running else normal failing exhausted; platform duplicate busy. Removal warns on failure.

Emergency restart dumps, marks restarting and calls machine layer. Restart, halt and power-off prepare notifying halt versus power-off, marking state, disabling helpers, shutting devices, pinning CPU, shutting syscore, announcing, flushing and dumping before machine action; power-off uses temporary legacy adapter and availability query. Privileged control checks capability and magic, delegates child namespaces, dispatches restart, CAD, halt, power-off, bounded argument restart and kexec or suspend, rewriting incapable power-off to halt and terminating caller while holding transition mutex. Orderly defers to workqueue with emergency fallback.

Pid signal helpers deliver through thread-group path resolving pid to task under read-side protection, retrying on unhash or leader race until stable target signaled or absence confirmed, unlocking before returning result.

Relay mmap checks length, binds buffer disabling expansion faulting to vmalloc pages failing unbound as allocation failure and bad page as bus error. Creation validates geometry else absent, teardown idempotent with flush completing partials. Files suffix CPU with failures to absence recording early size. Switch advances, consume clamps, stats aggregate by flag; oversized tallied, finalized polls error, empty geometry and overflow rejected.

Resource insertion reports conflicts with busy indication, child release detaches whole subtrees, and lookup finds siblings by start key. Filtered walks visit soft reservations, busy memory and busy system memory converting to page-frame intervals, with page residency test and guarded soft-reservation intersection check.

hazards.text: Resource display hides numeric extents from unprivileged viewers with capability-gated disclosure, width adaptation and fallback naming. Child release emits debug trace per detached entry. Reallocation reports busy when resizing entry with descendants and asserts absence of conflict after atomic detach and reinsertion.

invariants.text: Offset zero oldest, larger newer; past-end or inconsistent not-found, target must filter. Sampling holds sighand lock masked with head reference, later lockless, assuming tracer. Known for kernel marker, de-thread threshold, netlink marker, or above user marker within signal or poll limits. Unknown needs zeroed tail else too-big; compat clears then copies header and payload widening addresses with child time variant.
Range comparator orders live entries by start for sorting.

Platform reuses one static handler busy if used, others fresh. Initial reboot enables attention flag and reboot default, panic undefined with protection shutdown, ACPI type, cleared CPU, force, halt-fallback, pid and legacy hook; mode hard on one build unset on another. Reboot and resource logs share prefixes.

Forced power-off sticks once set. Protection accepts two actions reporting undefined otherwise, replacing default at trigger; stores need admin. Mode, type, force and cpu render settings, need boot capability, validate names or ranges, clear default and reject unknown. CAD pid reads numeric protected; writes resolve, exchange, wait for readers then release old.

Storage zeroed page array as one vmalloc region with linkage, page-rounded cleaning fully on partial failure. Fullness from produced minus consumed versus count counting full with start callback influence. Shared single zero-indexed or per-CPU reusing and cleaning fully on failure. Reads advance baseline on overwrite, skip padding exposing committed bytes holding inode guard.

Space search honors bounds and alignment with optional custom placement, clips gaps, excludes early reservations, guards overflow and underflow and reports busy when no gap remains. Hierarchy walk proceeds depth-first favoring descendants halting at supplied root. Auxiliary records obtained zeroed and freed only when slab-backed, leaking early boot allocations.

locks.text: Global system transition mutex serializes reboot and shutdown transitions.

Global relay reset serializes iteration over possible CPU buffers with channels mutex while single global reset bypasses it; wakeup uses deferred interrupt-safe path avoiding scheduler lock interaction.
Single read-write guard protects whole resource hierarchy with shared mode for traversal and display iteration and exclusive mode for allocation.

state_machines.text: Hardware protection trigger runs once per boot recording action, arming delayed forced fallback, then starting orderly reboot or forced shutdown; delayed worker forces recorded action and finally attempts emergency restart.
Relay read consume advances consumption baseline tracking completed units.

structs.text: Shutdown record links notifier chain with callback plus opaque data, mode tag, blocking flag, list selector and device pointer set by device-managed registration. Dispatcher pairs channel buffer reference with filesystem entry for creation to lookup handoff.
Channel holds counts, size, name, parent, callbacks and per-CPU pointers to buffers with start, pages, padding, produced, consumed, offsets, wait and stats; reset syncs wakeup before clearing.
Three global roots anchor bus port space, full memory space and soft-reserved memory with dedicated descriptor and address-kind flags; display indentation caps ancestor traversal at eight levels.

Helper path limited 256 bytes with power-off and reboot defaults. Modes cold, warm, hard, soft, gpio, undefined with types triple, keyboard, bios, acpi, efi, pci under mode, force, type, cpu and protection. Sysctls expose command, CAD enable and CAD pid with distinct modes.
